Relative recall was **6/6 (100%)** against the small, screened development set. This is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity. No user-supplied seeds or matching prior-review benchmark were available. The internal critiques were same-context; **PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use**.

The query uses an Entrez-date bound, not a publication-date limit. Some records already in PubMed by the cutoff have later publication years. The current MeSH index includes a COVID-19 heading introduced in 2021 (2020), so this run does not recreate the exact historical PubMed index. The broad OR block also brings substantial screening work.
